bio.en: I play games the way the developers shipped them - blind, vanilla, no mods - and I finish them all the way: every room, every file, every line somebody wrote and almost nobody heard. Then I archive them, because digital things evaporate. Nobody repaints the museum. Plus live commentary on news, movies, tech, politics, and internet culture.
